_doc: Bundle registry: named, toggleable groups of assets the runtime resolves in priority order. Membership is by FAMILY (a whole parametric family) and/or explicit CONCEPTS. A concept's primary bundle is the highest-priority bundle that claims it; anything unclaimed falls to 'core' (always enabled). Disabling a bundle removes its concepts from runtime resolution (they fall to the labeled-box backstop). Enabled-state at runtime is overlaid from data/bundle_state.json (gitignored); this file is the catalog of bundles + their default enabled flag.

bundles.name: Core
bundles.description: Essential hand-built concepts + primitives. Always on; the default home for any concept no other bundle claims.

bundles.name: Weather
bundles.description: Sky and weather props for water-cycle and climate lessons.

bundles.name: Animals
bundles.description: The four parametric animal families (quadrupeds, birds, fish, bugs).

bundles.name: Science
bundles.description: Celestial bodies, cells/microscopy, anatomy, and lab/physics props.

bundles.name: Vehicles
bundles.description: Cars, bikes, buses, trucks, trains, planes, rockets, boats.

bundles.name: Buildings & Places
bundles.description: Houses, schools, towers, and other places.

bundles.name: Folk Tales
bundles.description: Props and characters for folk-tale and adventure stories.

bundles.name: Effects
bundles.description: Accent marks: stars, sparkles, splashes, glows.

bundles.name: Backgrounds
bundles.description: Scene backdrops (gradient stages); paint-time, not foreground props.

bundles.name: Imported (Excalidraw)
bundles.description: Synced Excalidraw library icons (MIT), normalized to board strokes. Candidates — DISABLED by default so technical diagram icons never pollute cartoon lessons; enable a bundle or publish individual icons through the gates to use them.
